summary:
A widespread connection timeout reaching host 34.182.220.106 accounts for the vast majority of new failures, led by two major shared incidents causing 163 test failures across 77 tools and 153 test failures across 73 tools. The captured errors show HTTP connection attempts timing out after ten minutes during input staging and job checks, which likely indicates a network-level reachability issue with that specific IP host rather than a bug in the tools. Meanwhile, known persistent infrastructure issues remain stable, led by empty dataset output errors across 25 tools.

The absence of database connection pool timeout errors in the server log indicates that the test runner server was not experiencing internal overload during this run. This makes server-side resource exhaustion an unlikely explanation, pointing instead toward an external network-path or routing problem reaching host 34.182.220.106.
